digest.component_or_area: ruff ARG linting sweep across src/rebar
propositions: ruff --select ARG detects 64 unused-parameter violations (ARG001/ARG002/ARG005) across src/rebar that must be dispositioned by classification procedure without enabling a permanent gate

Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers use runtime string introspection to conditionally pass repo_root/binding_store, making naive _-rename unsafe; resolution is to normalize unused params to **_kwargs catch-all

Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol implementations receive parameters pinned by protocol contract and keyword call sites, making _-rename a contract break; resolution is to leave raw (cannot noqa due to RUF100 unused-noqa conflict)
Three tracked real defects (timeout_s, close_reason, acli_cmd) are excluded from this sweep and left in place to be fixed separately
Enabling ARG as a permanent gate would require 7+ irreducible inline # noqa exceptions, conflicting with project policy against per-site exemptions

Post-sweep verification must confirm ARG violations are reduced to only deliberately-retained set (tracked defects and rename-unsafe params left raw) while maintaining identical observable reconciler and outbound-mapping behavior
